nodes.label: Protected Route Guard (redirect to / when no token)
nodes.norm_label: protected route guard (redirect to / when no token)

nodes.label: RequireAdmin Route Guard (id_role === 1)
nodes.rationale: Non-admins are redirected to /dashboard rather than bounced to "/", so a signed-in user who follows an admin link lands somewhere useful instead of being logged out visually.

nodes.label: App.jsx Routing and Route Guards
nodes.rationale: Every path is enumerated with a wildcard fallback that navigates to "/"; guards wrap only the pages that need identity.

nodes.label: Stroked line-icon style (stroke #aa3bff, width 1.35, round caps)
nodes.norm_label: stroked line-icon style (stroke #aa3bff, width 1.35, round caps)

nodes.label: Display-P3 Wide-Gamut Color Fallback
nodes.rationale: Every fill is declared twice in a style attribute: an sRGB hex fallback first (e.g. #7e14ff) followed by `fill:color(display-p3 ...)` with a longer float form. This is the Figma SVG-export pattern — the hex keeps the mark correct on older renderers, the P3 value renders the more saturated gradient on wide-gamut displays.

nodes.label: Browser Tab / Bookmark Identity
nodes.rationale: The asset is served at /favicon.svg and referenced from index.html as `type="image/svg+xml"`, so its only job is identification in a 16x16 browser-tab slot and in bookmark lists. That is why the design is a single bold silhouette with a flat gradient and no text: shapes that survive being shrunk to favicon scale.

nodes.label: Off-Canvas Gallery Bleed Requiring Mask Crop
nodes.norm_label: off-canvas gallery bleed requiring mask crop
nodes.rationale: The blur ellipses are deliberately positioned at coordinates outside the 48x46 viewBox (e.g. cy=-6.092, cy=38.332 with ry=29.108, and rotate(37.892) transforms). Without the alpha mask the blurred artwork would spill into surrounding page space, so the mask crops the effect back to the bolt silhouette. The mask and the oversized ellipses exist as a pair.

nodes.label: Thin grey outline over flat-fill rendering
nodes.norm_label: thin grey outline over flat-fill rendering

nodes.label: Violet page-edge accent on lower slab
nodes.norm_label: violet page-edge accent on lower slab

nodes.label: Isometric stacked-slab extrusion visual style
nodes.rationale: Two identical slabs drawn in isometric projection and offset vertically read as a solid book; dashed vertical guides between them imply an in-progress extrusion/animation, giving depth without text or literal book detail. The empty, wordless slabs leave the artwork agnostic to any specific book the app later swaps in.

nodes.label: Unused Vite Template Asset (no importer in src/ or index.html)
nodes.norm_label: unused vite template asset (no importer in src/ or index.html)

nodes.label: Build and Lint Verification (Vite 8, 1904 modules)
nodes.rationale: Final gate before hand-off: `npm run build` green (Vite 8, 1904 modules, ~310 kB JS bundle / ~100 kB gzip) and `npm run lint` clean with 0 errors and 0 warnings.

nodes.label: Perpustakaan Web Frontend (React + Vite + Tailwind v4)
nodes.norm_label: perpustakaan web frontend (react + vite + tailwind v4)
nodes.rationale: Front end of a library system, rebuilt from an empty template into an interactive bookshelf landing page plus a login flow wired to the Go backend.

nodes.label: React + Vite Minimal Template
nodes.rationale: Unmodified create-vite boilerplate: a minimal React setup with HMR and a few ESLint rules. It documents the starting point, not the project.

nodes.label: Dangling '# perpustakaan-frontend-ui' Heading
nodes.rationale: A single stray project-name line appended below the stock Vite text; unclear whether it is a stale earlier name for the project or an accidental paste.

nodes.label: BukuTab.jsx Deleted Outside This Session
nodes.rationale: `src/components/BukuTab.jsx` shows as ` D` in git status although the author never touched it and `src/components` was already empty at session start; left unclaimed rather than silently reverted, pending confirmation it is not residue of an older commit.

nodes.label: Backend .env / JWT Secret Out of Report Scope
nodes.norm_label: backend .env / jwt secret out of report scope
nodes.rationale: JWT secrets live in the sibling `perpustakaan-api` project; the report explicitly excludes them so no secret material is claimed as frontend scope.

nodes.label: Open Items and Risks
nodes.rationale: A deliberately unresolved list rather than a clean bill of health: five items the author could not close within the session.

nodes.label: Initial Project Cleanup of Malformed src Directories
nodes.norm_label: initial project cleanup of malformed src directories
nodes.rationale: Deliberate first step before any page work: remove `src\017mponents` (a folder whose name contained a 0x0F control byte) and the `srcpages` typo folder, then empty the already-blank `src/components` and `src/pages` so the tree could be rebuilt cleanly.

nodes.label: index.css Leftover Sliding-Overlay Template CSS
nodes.rationale: Dead *sliding overlay* classes from the original Vite template are still in index.css; judged safe to delete but left in place because they do not affect runtime.

nodes.label: React Compiler Disabled in Template
nodes.rationale: The compiler is left off in this template specifically because of its impact on dev and build performance; enabling it is a deliberate opt-in.

nodes.label: Recommendation to Adopt TypeScript with Type-Aware Lint Rules
nodes.norm_label: recommendation to adopt typescript with type-aware lint rules
nodes.rationale: For a production application the template advises TypeScript plus type-aware lint rules and points at the TS template and typescript-eslint — none of which this project actually adopted (it stayed plain JSX).

nodes.label: AdminResetPassword.jsx — Admin Password Reset (PUT)
nodes.rationale: The one endpoint in the app requiring both Bearer auth and the Admin role; body {username, new_password}, reached only through the RequireAdmin guard.

nodes.label: Backend Endpoint Integration Map
nodes.rationale: Each of the four endpoints is pinned to exactly one page (or two), with its request schema, response shape and auth requirement, so the frontend's coupling to the backend is explicit and reviewable.

nodes.label: src/utils/auth.js — Token/Session Helper (set, get, clear)
nodes.rationale: Session persistence is funnelled through one helper (set/get/clear of token and user) instead of scattered localStorage calls, which is what makes the route guards cheap.

nodes.label: src/api/client.js — Axios Instance with Bearer Token Interceptor
nodes.norm_label: src/api/client.js — axios instance with bearer token interceptor
nodes.rationale: A single shared Axios instance carries baseURL http://localhost:8080 and a request interceptor that injects `Authorization: Bearer <token>` from localStorage, so authenticated endpoints such as admin reset-password need no per-call token plumbing.

nodes.label: Book Click → /login with bookTitle / bookColor Route State
nodes.norm_label: book click → /login with booktitle / bookcolor route state
nodes.rationale: Clicking a spine navigates with `navigate('/login', {state: {bookTitle, bookColor}})` so the login hero can render the exact book that was clicked; the modal variant was rejected precisely because a separate modal broke this handoff.

nodes.label: Buku Model (id_buku, judul, penulis, deskripsi, gambar, stok)
nodes.norm_label: buku model (id_buku, judul, penulis, deskripsi, gambar, stok)

nodes.label: Dashboard.jsx — Book Catalog with Search
nodes.rationale: Navbar + welcome hero + search toolbar over a card grid of GET /buku results, cover images served from `/uploads/` (prefixed with the backend origin) and a stock badge on each card.

nodes.label: Final src/ File Structure
nodes.rationale: Each file is tagged (B) dibuat baru / (M) dimodifikasi / (T) tidak berubah so the report can state exactly how much of the Vite template survived.

nodes.label: Landing Dummy Book List Fallback
nodes.rationale: Dummy books fill the shelves and stand in entirely when the backend is down, so the landing page never renders as an empty grey grid during local development.

nodes.label: Landing.jsx — 2-Tier Interactive Bookshelf
nodes.rationale: Final landing design (iteration 11): cream `bg-[#F3EFE6]` field, two thick wooden shelves (`bg-gradient from-[#A67C52] to-[#8B5A2B]`, h-5, highlight + shadow), 22 books per row for 44 total drawn from GET /buku and padded with dummy data, textless books in a retro/earth-tone palette, height 120–255px, thickness 14–34px, some rotated ±3–6deg, one horizontal stack per 8 books, hover lift with `-translate-y` and 3D shadow, a white serif pill badge (bg-white/95 backdrop-blur) reading the title and 'Klik untuk Pinjam', and a `blur-2xl` glow behind the shelves for depth.

nodes.label: Login Flow (POST /login → localStorage token+user → /dashboard)
nodes.rationale: The report states explicitly that this flow never changed across any of the eleven UI iterations — only the surrounding design moved, so the auth behaviour was treated as a fixed contract.

nodes.label: Login.jsx — Hero Login Split Layout
nodes.rationale: Left column carries a small 'Perpustakaan' badge, the headline 'Buku impianmu, tinggal satu klik lagi.' and a large hero book rendered in the clicked book's colour (tilted, shadowed); the right column is the plain form card (Username, Password, `Masuk` button bg-slate-900). Defaults are 'Laskar Pelangi' plus a hashed colour when no state arrives.

nodes.label: Minimal Single-Card Design Direction
nodes.rationale: The direction that survived: one `max-w-md` card on a flat light ground, Linear/Vercel-style (bg-slate-100 card, bg-slate-900 button), later refined with a `border-t-zinc-900` accent border over a gradient.

nodes.label: Register.jsx — Registration Form
nodes.rationale: POST /register with body {username, password} returning only a {message}; only an unused `navigate` variable was removed during linting, the function itself is unchanged.

nodes.label: Rejection of Neon / AI-Generic UI Concepts
nodes.norm_label: rejection of neon / ai-generic ui concepts
nodes.rationale: Three directions were killed on taste grounds rather than technical ones: the split-screen gradient + glassmorphism login was judged 'neon/AI slop', the dot-grid + 'Buku Paling Dipinjam' preview card was judged a 'widget AI dump', and the bookshelf landing + login modal was dropped because it turned out to be a modal, not the intent.

nodes.label: Dashboard Fetch Deferral for react-hooks/set-state-in-effect
nodes.rationale: `loading` initialised to `false`, a `fetched` flag added, and the fetch deferred with `setTimeout(0)` — done specifically to satisfy the `react-hooks/set-state-in-effect` lint rule, not to change behaviour.

nodes.label: UI Design Iteration History (11 Rounds)
nodes.rationale: The table records rejected as well as accepted directions with the reason attached, so the final look is a documented outcome of iteration rather than a first guess.

nodes.label: GET /buku Requires No Authentication (Open Risk)
nodes.rationale: Because the backend exposes GET /buku without auth, Landing and Dashboard fetch it tokenless; the report flags that the Dashboard route is still login-guarded even though the data it reads is not.
